name: ModelVariant829_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant829_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a camera sequence follows the duel, then streaks of light leave a model part in fours and fly towards the other slot, each bursting into an animated sprite when it arrives, while sprites rain on the other slot and the ambient level dips and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, clears the streaks, scatters 64 sprites around the other slot and packs one texture image, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the delay, 4 while the streaks are emitted, 1 once when emission ends, 2 once the last burst has played and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-846 and 943 images build it from the same source with the US layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
